moats.claim: A painting-specific brush ecosystem and artist workflows provide specialization relative to general photo editors.

productReasons.claim: Multiple brush engines and stabilization provide fine control for digital painting.
SVG vector tools and text templates support comic panels and speech bubbles.
Custom workspaces, dockers and shortcuts adapt the interface to illustration workflows.

sponsorship.notes: Intel gold sponsor since 2022; FossHub monthly donor since 2019 on current sponsor page. Historical grants listed separately on page; not equity.
